audience: support teams who work shared inboxes in Helpwise

useCases.title: Review open conversations in an inbox
useCases.text: The AI lists conversations of an inbox by folder with subject, tags, assignee and flags, and opens one to read its messages and notes.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a contact
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts by name, email or phone and reads one with company, custom fields and recent conversations. It can create a contact or change its fields.

useCases.title: Check team performance and tag reports
useCases.text: The AI reads new and closed conversations, response and resolution times, CSAT and per-agent figures for a date range, and conversations per tag for one inbox.

useCases.title: Tag, assign, close or reopen conversations
useCases.text: The AI applies tags, assigns conversations to a team member, closes up to 25 conversations or moves them back to the inbox. Nothing is sent to customers.

useCases.title: Add an internal note to a conversation
useCases.text: The AI adds a note that only your team sees, for example a summary of a long thread or a hand-over remark.

useCases.title: Send an email from an inbox
useCases.text: The AI sends one email from a Helpwise inbox to up to 10 recipients. It starts a new message and cannot be recalled.
